title: Project Lead/Head - (Data Center Project) - Vizag
description:
**Job Title**
 Project Lead/Head \- (Data Center Project) \- Vizag
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role drives end\-to\-end project delivery, managing planning, coordination, quality, safety, commissioning, and handover. They act as the central point for technical, operational, and managerial decision\-making, ensuring the project meets timeline, cost, quality, and reliability objectives.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Lead planning, coordination, and execution of all project activities across civil, MEP, electrical, HVAC, ELV/BMS, and IT systems.
* Review designs, ensure integration across disciplines, and compliance with data centre standards.
* Monitor site progress, quality, safety, and resource utilization.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors, and subcontractors to resolve issues.
* Oversee testing, commissioning, and handover, ensuring operational readiness and documentation.


**About You**
* Should have 8\+ years in Data Centre projects and overall experience of 20\+ years
* Diploma/ B E in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering
* Should have completed end to end process of at least 4 data centres.

title: Construction Manager - (Industrial Projects) - Vizag
description:
**Job Title**
 Construction Manager \- (Industrial Projects) \- Vizag
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role supports end\-to\-end delivery of large\-scale construction projects, assisting in project planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, and contract administration. The role includes monitoring site execution, ensuring quality standards, safety compliance, and risk mitigation. Works closely with multidisciplinary teams, consultants, clients, and contractors to support timely project completion within scope and budget, while contributing to cost efficiency, operational excellence, and overall client satisfaction across all civil project phases.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Oversee end\-to\-end management of civil construction projects from initiation to completion
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets in alignment with project objectives
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams including engineers, consultants, contractors, and site supervisors
* Monitor project progress, milestones, and deliverables to ensure timely execution
* Oversee procurement planning, vendor evaluation, and material management to maintain cost efficiency
* Administer contracts, review variations, and manage claims and billing in coordination with QS and commercial teams
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, environmental, and statutory regulations at all project stages
* Conduct regular site inspections and audits to monitor work quality and adherence to design specifications
* Identify project risks and implement effective mitigation and contingency strategies
* Coordinate with clients, architects, consultants, and internal stakeholders to maintain clear communication and alignment
* Ensure all civil works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, standards, and best practices
* Support project closure activities, including documentation, handover, and final settlement


**About You**
* B.E. / B. Tech in Civil Engineering
* 5 to 8 Years \& above of relevant experience
* Should have completed at least 4\- 6 institutional/University/residential/Commercial/industrial or similar projects along with infra works projects end to end during the tenure
* Candidate working with Project Management Consultancy would be preferred
* Technical awareness of civil, electro\-mechanical, and architectural works
* Excellent organizational and motivational skills
* Outstanding attention to detail and observation ability
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities
